neighbors: 1999 Tourism Concern and Independent Travelers World Award
edges: Amanda Marks believes that the ecotourism industry still has some way to go to get its house in order.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Ecotourism has become overcrowded in its role in the world economy.
Ecotourism Society aims to promote ecotourism as a genuine tool for conservation and sustainable development.
Ecotourism has undergone growing pains but shows signs of improvement for the better.
